---
title: "Gridwell"
subtitle: "Fast multi-format table rendering from a declarative IR"
---

**Gridwell** is a Rust library that accepts a rich table Intermediate Representation (IR) and
renders it to many output formats. It serves as a universal table rendering backend.

## Key Features

- **11 output formats** from a single declarative JSON input
- **Sub-millisecond rendering** for typical tables (Rust core)
- **Language bindings** for Python (PyO3), R (extendr), and C (FFI)
- **Rigorous validation** catches structural errors before rendering
- **CLI tool** for command-line conversions

## Supported Formats

| Format | Type   | Description               |
|--------|--------|---------------------------|
| HTML   | Text   | Semantic HTML5 table      |
| LaTeX  | Text   | longtable with booktabs   |
| Typst  | Text   | Typst table markup        |
| RTF    | Text   | Rich Text Format          |
| SVG    | Text   | Standalone SVG image      |
| ANSI   | Text   | Terminal output            |
| Pandoc | Text   | Pandoc AST JSON           |
| Quarto | Text   | Quarto Markdown           |
| DOCX   | Binary | Microsoft Word            |
| XLSX   | Binary | Microsoft Excel           |
| PPTX   | Binary | Microsoft PowerPoint      |

## How It Works

```text
┌─────────────────────────┐
│  Upstream Tool          │
│  (gt / Great Tables)    │
└───────────┬─────────────┘
            │ IR (JSON)
            ▼
┌─────────────────────────┐
│  gridwell               │
│  Parse → Validate       │
│  → Render               │
└───────────┬─────────────┘
            │
    ┌───────┼───────┐
    ▼       ▼       ▼
  HTML    LaTeX   DOCX  ... (11 formats)
```

## Quick Example

```bash
# Convert a table IR to HTML
gridwell convert table.json --to html

# Validate an IR file
gridwell validate table.json

# Pipe from stdin
cat table.json | gridwell convert --to latex
```
